findings.text: a manifest that records its two suite arms as one nested object keyed by arm name is not resolvable by _gate_log_path, which reads a flat object's log_path, and read_review would therefore annotate this run's record with added_failure_count=null (unmeasured) even though both arms' gate logs exist and this review derived 0 from them; the record stored here carries the count and the empty id list directly, and the nested shape is the reviewed run's own manifest rather than a defect in the landed change.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against aff594161bf1098fe807fa73b41180db35d32130; 4c4bffb09 changes the five test files, e1537020a adds the evidence fragment only
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the five ticker test files under both a TERM=dumb NO_COLOR=1 arm and a TERM=xterm-256color NO_COLOR-unset arm; the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite record four runs and their logs
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make the ticker tests hold at head under any caller terminal; the diff pins each environment fact (NO_COLOR, model-cell geometry, stdout stream, help wording) at the test that reads it
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command, the four arm results with exit codes and failing ids, the four failure groups with every base id, and names logs/base-arm-*.log and logs/head-arm-*.log

justifications.durability: tests/test_ticker_node_names_keep_their_ends.py:52 takes its column offset from grid.model_width rather than the module constant, so the node-cell assertion reddens if the model cell or the columns after it move; the geometry pins measure the row at a fixed cell width, which is the determinism section 35 prescribes and which leaves the config-resolved alias path to tests/test_ticker_row_is_one_transition.py.
justifications.evidence: the four logs record both arms with no ambiguity: logs/base-arm-dumb.log (30 failed, EXIT=1), logs/base-arm-colour.log (22 failed, EXIT=1), logs/head-arm-dumb.log (215 passed, EXIT=0) and logs/head-arm-colour.log (215 passed, EXIT=0); the head logs contain no FAILED line against a base log that names 30, so the set difference over node ids is empty and the added-failure count is a measured 0 rather than an unmeasured value.
justifications.fit: the terminal facts are pinned with the file's existing monkeypatch idiom (tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:253) and the added comments describe the mechanism without a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:80 pins model_aliases=() on the grid fixture and tests/test_crew_ticker.py:430 deletes NO_COLOR, so each environment fact the failed ids depended on is pinned where it is read rather than left to the caller's terminal.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only the five declared test files and the evidence fragment, and the declared source paths reckon/crew/ticker.py and reckon/flight.py are absent from the diff entirely.
